title: Agent Delegation Audit Event
description: One decision in an agent delegation chain. Hash-chained, tamper-evident, offline-verifiable. Published as an open standard so SIEMs and observability tools can ingest agent-authority decisions in a common format. Covers schema versions 1 and 2: a chain is created at ONE version and never mixes (stated once, on its `root` entry); version 2 (0.9.0) adds execution binding — `call_id` on every allow/deny, the `outcome` event, and the params_c14n_v1 argument commitments. A version-1 entry never carries any version-2-only field.

v.description: Schema version, stated on the `root` entry and inherited by every entry in the chain.

c14n.description: Informational canonicalization label; verifiers enforce RFC 8785 by recomputing the event hash over JCS bytes.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; gaps are provable evidence of deletion.

ts.description: Trusted timestamp (RFC 3339 string) or monotonic integer in tests.

event.description: root=chain start; spawn=delegation minted; allow/deny=action authorization; kill=cascade revocation; done=node lifecycle end (holder finished; informational); outcome=(v2 only) what happened after an allowed call — see call_id/body_state below.

task.description: Natural-language task the delegation was scoped to.

reason.description: Denial reason: scope | egress | max_rows | max_spend | max_depth | max_fanout | chain_ceiling | chain_revoked.

revoked.description: Node ids revoked by a kill.

strikes.description: Same-scope denial count that tripped the strike policy (kill with reason=strike_policy).

mode.description: Strike policy mode (same_scope|total) on a strike-policy kill.

disposition.description: deny only: WHY the scope was not in the node's authority — held pending an operator grant (waiting on a human) | withheld tier-2 (resolvable only to a heuristic never granted) | unresolved (no authority known for the tool) | out_of_authority (resolved and grantable, but not held by this node: over-reach).

call_id.description: v2 only. On allow/deny/outcome: 16 CSPRNG bytes, lowercase hex, allocated inside check()'s locked transition. Unique per allow/deny in a chain (duplicate_call_id at verification); an outcome's call_id must match exactly one allow, never a deny.

capture.description: v2 allow only. What the adapter's code path will observe for this call — observation CAPABILITY, not a claim of quality. pre_hook_only means no outcome is promised.

adapter.description: v2 allow only, required alongside capture: the adapter code path that produced this record.

authorized_params_hash.description: v2 allow only. params_c14n_v1: SHA-256(raw_salt || UTF8(JCS(authorized_params))), lowercase hex. Absent (with params_hash_reason) when authorized_params is outside the params_c14n_v1 domain; absent with no reason when the deployment never attempted a commitment.

params_salt.description: v2 root entry only: 16 raw bytes, hex-encoded, fixed for the chain's lifetime — the salt every authorized_params_hash/invoked_params_hash in this chain is computed against.

params_hash_reason.description: v2 allow/outcome only: present exactly when the corresponding hash field (authorized_params_hash / invoked_params_hash) is absent because the value was outside the params_c14n_v1 domain. Illegal alongside the hash field it names.

body_state.description: v2 outcome only: an OBSERVATION of how the body-owning wrapper's call ended, not a judgment about the world.

error_code.description: v2 outcome only, required exactly when body_state == raised (a normalized exception class name, never a message); illegal for every other body_state.

invoked_params_hash.description: v2 outcome only: same params_c14n_v1 commitment as authorized_params_hash, over the arguments the wrapper observed immediately before the actual invocation.

duration_ms.description: v2 outcome only, required: observation start to observation end, milliseconds.

receipt.description: v2 outcome only, optional: unverified carriage from an external observer — the library verifies nothing about it.

pending_at_kill.description: v2 kill only: call_ids, across every node this kill revoked, that had not yet received an outcome at the moment of revocation. A snapshot, not a clearing — a later outcome for one of these call_ids is still accepted.
